name: How long does a typical final walkthrough take?
description: The length of a final walkthrough depends on project size and complexity, ranging from one hour to several hours.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical final walkthrough take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a final walkthrough can vary significantly based on the size and complexity of the construction project. A small renovation might take an hour, while a large custom home or commercial build could require several hours. As a Process Clarity point, Hometelligent Inc. schedules walkthroughs with ample time, advising clients that they should not feel rushed, allowing for a thorough inspection of every aspect of the completed work.
